notes: Step 1 parts were correct; no parts added or dropped.
Circuit: pin 13 -> orange wire -> breadboard column 3 -> 220 ohm resistor -> column 6 -> LED anode (bent/long leg); LED cathode in column 8 -> black wire -> GND next to pin 13.

The image's breadboard is drawn with rows j..f on the upper half; per the catalogue naming, those rows are bank 'b' (rows f-j), so holes are written like 6b.i. Column positions were read from the image: resistor in columns 3 and 6 (row h), LED in columns 6 and 8 (row i), wires in row g of columns 3 and 8.
The GND header pin next to AREF/13 is mapped to GND.1; the catalogue does not say which of the three GND ports is that one.
The resistor is symmetric, so which leg is port 1 and which is port 2 is arbitrary.
The main tutorial example uses the board's built-in LED; only the optional external LED circuit is modelled.
